6.content:
Incoming Call (632727963, org 605418)

Purpose

Ivy Rehab Patient Engagement Center call handling. Greets the caller, routes the reason for the call to one of ~15 subtrees, and on the scheduling path creates the Raintree lead, case, appointment and contacts.

Node map - lead creation path

100 Combined Summary        --[Create Lead]--> 105 Submit Data to Raintree (Script)
105 -> 128 Format Lead Comments (Script) -> 1   Find Existing Lead (Data)
  1 -> 2   Check Lead Search and Map Raintree Codes (Script)
  2 -> 5   Existing Lead Found? (Scoring)
             is_existing_lead == 'true' -> 9 Select Existing Lead (Content, Dynamic View)
             default                   -> 107 Raintree - Create Lead (Data)
  9 -> 10  Apply Selected Lead (Script) -> 161 Has Patient Number? (true -> 132, else -> 129) -> 132 Get Patient Details
107 -> 126 Is Lead Created? -> 127 Is Lead Created Success?
             true  -> 128 Format Lead Comments -> 130 Lead Created Successfully
             false -> 129 Lead Already Exists
129 / 130 -> 131 Set Patient Number -> 132 Get Patient Details -> ... -> 154 API Success

Node map - patient insurance

141 Raintree Search & Update Appointment -> 162 Stage Patient Insurance (Script)
162 -> 163 Create Patient Insurance? (Scoring)
          is_create_patient_insurance == 'true' -> 164 Raintree Create Patient Insurance (Data: get_token + 1132)
          default                               -> 142
164 -> 142
151 grades raintree__create_patient_insurance with the other calls (patient_insurance_api_success).

Data dictionary - variables added by this change

  • lead_search_dob - patient date of birth as ISO yyyy-mm-dd. Written by node 105, read only by the raintree__find_leads Connected Object query string.
  • is_existing_lead - string flag, "true" / "false". Written by node 2, read by the router on node 5.
  • lead_disciplines_json - serialised JSON array of DPAY codes, e.g. ["PT","OT"]. Written by node 2, read only by the raintree__create_lead body (unquoted merge field). Source: discipline_selection if the SNPA dropdown set it, else every value in therapy_type ("PT,OT") resolved against DPAY.
  • lead_primary_reason - CASET code, e.g. "HIP". Written by node 2, read only by the raintree__create_lead body. Resolved from body_part (whole value, then each word), then therapy_type. Never free text - Raintree 400s on anything that is not a CASET code.
  • 2026-09-17 - CR-3: nodes 9 and 10 added. A lead hit now lists every match in a Dynamic View grid, the agent picks one, and its patient number flows into Get Patient Details. Node 5's true branch moved from 129 to 9.

The last three are invisible to the export lint because Connected Object bodies are not part of the tree JSON.

External systems

  • raintree__create_patient_insurance (1132) - POST /patients/${patient_number}/insurances. Body reads patient_insurance_rt_code, effective_year, subscriber_id, group_number, subscriber_relationship, subscriber_first_name, subscriber_middle_initial, subscriber_last_name, subscriber_dob_iso, subscriber_address, patient_city, patient_state, patient_zipcode, subscriber_phone. Node 162 stages the derived ones. Primary insurance only.
  • get_token (1021) - Raintree OAuth client-credentials token, TTL 86400.
  • raintree__find_leads - GET /lead, search by firstName + lastName + dob. Cache TTL 0.
  • raintree__get_disciplines - GET /customtables/DPAY. Therapy type codes.
  • raintree__get_case_types - GET /customtables/CASET. Case type codes (primaryReason).
  • raintree__create_lead (1067) - POST /lead.
  • clinicinfoprod (55) - clinic detail, rendered into the header of most screens.
  • 2026-09-17 - CR-3: nodes 9 and 10 added. A lead hit now lists every match in a Dynamic View grid, the agent picks one, and its patient number flows into Get Patient Details. Node 5's true branch moved from 129 to 9.

Gotchas

  • dob is ISO yyyy-mm-dd on the /lead query string but MM-DD-YYYY inside a lead record.
  • The create_lead body sends disciplines as an unquoted merge field. Publishing the tree and updating that Connected Object have to happen together, or the body is not valid JSON.
  • Node 127 still grades the create call. It is the backstop for a lead created between the search and the create, not dead code.
  • Node 10 and node 131 both stage the patient transform. That is deliberate, not a duplicate to collapse: 131 serves the hand-typed paths off nodes 129, 130 and 136, node 10 serves the Dynamic View path, and a Script node cannot follow a Script node.
  • If the agent continues off node 9 without picking a row, the patient number is empty, Get Patient Details 404s and node 134 routes to 136 Re-enter Patient Number. That is the existing bad-patient-number path doing its job - no extra guard needed.
  • views.* is keyed by the CONNECTED OBJECT alias, not a separate view name: views.raintree__find_leads. The Dynamic View grid is inserted on node 9 from the editor toolbar, so its widget markup is authored by Zingtree, not by hand.
  • Scripts in this tree predate the house standard and read bare identifiers (patient_dob rather than ZT.getVariableValue). New scripts use the standard.
  • 2026-09-17 - CR-3: nodes 9 and 10 added. A lead hit now lists every match in a Dynamic View grid, the agent picks one, and its patient number flows into Get Patient Details. Node 5's true branch moved from 129 to 9.

Changelog

  • 2026-10-08 (pm) - Insurance sent by code only (10/8 call: Raintree fills in the name). Node 162 no longer resolves a name; router 163 POSTs when patient_insurance_rt_code and subscriber_id are present.
  • 2026-10-08 - Create patient insurance. New nodes 162 (stage), 163 (router), 164 (get_token + raintree__create_patient_insurance) between 141 and 142. Runs here, not in Schedule New Patient, because it needs the patient number. Node 151 grades the call. Insurance code comes from Schedule New Patient node 200.
  • 2026-10-06 - Summary missing on 129. Node 128 (builds Summary_HTML / summary_text) moved ahead of the lead search: 105 -> 128 -> 1, and 127 true now goes straight to 130. 129 now renders ${transforms.Summary_HTML} like 130.
  • 2026-10-06 - Selected lead with no chart (blank pn) no longer dead-ends. Node 10 writes has_lead_patient_number; new router 161 sends it to 132 when true, else to 129 Lead Already Exists (convert lead, enter patient number).
  • 2026-10-05 - Node 105 stages comment_json (comment escaped for a quoted JSON slot). Create Lead body reads "comm": "${comment_json}" so quotes or line breaks in the comment no longer break the request.
  • 2026-10-05 - Node 5 routed on actions.raintree__find_leads.records.length, which throws when Raintree returns no records array (no lead found), so new patients could not get past node 5. Node 2 now writes is_existing_lead as "true"/"false" and node 5 routes on is_existing_lead == 'true'.
  • 2026-09-29 - Node 2 only: therapy_type may hold several values ("PT,OT"), so disciplines now resolve each one (discipline_selection wins when present). primaryReason also tries each word of body_part so "Back/L calf" sends BACK instead of free text. is_existing_lead now uses the same records-length test as node 5. Null-safe when a lookup call fails. Create Lead body must use ${lead_primary_reason} and ${lead_disciplines_json}, NOT ${body_part} / ["${discipline_selection}"] (that version caused the 9/28-9/29 400s: "Invalid primary reason: BACK/L CALF"). Node 5 untouched.
  • 2026-09-17 - Added nodes 1, 2 and 5: lead search before create, and DPAY/CASET code resolution for disciplines and primaryReason. Node 105 gained the ISO date and now points at node 1. Requirements: Requirements/Ivy Rehab/incoming-call-requirements.md CR-1, CR-2.
  • 2026-09-17 - CR-3: nodes 9 and 10 added. A lead hit now lists every match in a Dynamic View grid, the agent picks one, and its patient number flows into Get Patient Details. Node 5's true branch moved from 129 to 9.
